name: Toll of the Invasion
oracle_text:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
Amass Zombies 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It's also a Zombie. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token first.)
blocked_sentences: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card.

needs.what: a discard in which the target player reveals their hand and the spell's controller (not the discarding player) chooses a card matching a filter (here a nonland card) to be discarded -- Duress/Thoughtseize's shape; no discard if none matches
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `discard` takes only amount, as, player, random, up_to and whole_hand: op_discard always asks the discarding player (or picks at random) and has no filter on which card may be taken. `reveal` and `look_at_hand` show the hand but cannot hand the choice to the caster, restrict it to nonland cards, or perform a discard (so discard triggers and Tamiyo's forced-discard bar would be skipped by any move-to-graveyard workaround).
